tips_en: Start with the AskChem paper (Paper 1) as it offers a concrete, well-evaluated system tackling LLM hallucination via claim-level retrieval—this practical grounding frames the other two papers' more architectural contributions. All three address LLM limitations from complementary angles: AskChem grounds outputs externally through atomic claims, Metis integrates memory natively into the backbone, and OpenMLE enables recursive self-improvement via atomic evolution operators. The shared theme of decomposing complex tasks into atomic units and exposing them through modular interfaces (MCP, hyper memory blocks) makes reading them in sequence especially rewarding.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 AskChem（论文1），它提供了一个具体且经过充分评估的系统，通过声明级检索解决 LLM 幻觉问题——这一实践背景有助于理解另外两篇更具架构创新性的论文。三篇论文从互补的角度应对 LLM 的局限：AskChem 通过原子声明外部锚定输出，Metis 将记忆原生集成到骨干网络中，OpenMLE 则通过原子进化操作符实现递归自我改进。它们共同的核心思想是将复杂任务分解为原子单元，并通过模块化接口（MCP、超记忆块）实现协同，按顺序阅读会格外有收获。
